subgroup_flags.classification_notes: Obesity: enrolment required BMI > 40 kg/m2, so obese_population. Timing: intervention within 24h of initiation of mechanical ventilation, so early. PTP target: described as using decremental PEEP trial and end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure measurements, but no numeric target stated, so coded as other.

reported_subgroups.subgroup_variable: Enrolment period (first half vs second half of each cohort period)
reported_subgroups.result_verbatim: The standard protocol-based cohort mortality was 40% in the first 35 patients (2012–2013) and 42% in the second 35 patients (2013–2014). The mortality in the first 25 patients of the lung rescue team cohort was 28% (2015–2016) and 16% in the remaining 25 patients (2016–2017).

provenance.quote: The standard protocol-based cohort mortality was 40% in the first 35 patients (2012–2013) and 42% in the second 35 patients (2013–2014). The mortality in the first 25 patients of the lung rescue team cohort was 28% (2015–2016) and 16% in the remaining 25 patients (2016–2017).
provenance.location: Results, Mortality and in-hospital outcomes, para 3

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Considered possible overlap with fumagalli_2019 (mgh_lung_rescue cluster per COHORTS.md). The current study states 'None of these patients participated in any MGH ARDS ongoing interventional trials' and does not report a trial registration. Enrolment 2012-2017. Fumagalli (2019) is a separate study; no evidence of overlapping patients found in this report. Could not definitively confirm overlap without the other report.
unclear_items: balloon_guided_peep_titration: The exact method of transpulmonary pressure computation (absolute subtraction vs elastance-derived) is not reported.

Timing subgroup: The intervention started within 24h of initiation of mechanical ventilation, but the reference event is 'initiation of mechanical ventilation', which may correspond to intubation or ICU admission; classified as early_within_48h.
Potential cohort overlap with fumagalli_2019 could not be assessed because the report was not available for comparison (see overlap_evidence).
extraction_flags.general_notes: This is a retrospective cohort study, so comparison groups are sequential (2012-2014 vs 2015-2017). Mortality differences may be confounded by temporal changes in care.
